run_debug_lead_agent: run the debug script to interact with the lead agent via terminal input
initialize_mcp_tools: initialize MCP tools at startup using deerflow.mcp.initialize_mcp_tools
create_lead_agent: create a lead agent instance using deerflow.agents.make_lead_agent with configurable options
invoke_agent_async: invoke the lead agent asynchronously with a human message and configuration context
configure_agent_thread: configure the agent with thread_id, thinking_enabled, is_plan_mode, and model_name settings
